name: v11.5.3
body:
## What's Changed
* fix: unavailable stdin Fixes #1328 by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1329
* build(deps): bump @vitest/mocker from 4.1.10 to 4.1.11 in /web in the npm_and_yarn group across 1 directory by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1330
* storecrypto: reject ChunkRef indices above uint32 range by @armouldr in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1332
* test: fortify relay and updater tests by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1333
* feat: add packaging by @schollz in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1334

## New Contributors
* @armouldr made their first contribution in https://github.com/schollz/croc/pull/1332

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/schollz/croc/compare/v11.5.2...v11.5.3
